Confidence_Score.definition: A numerical value (1-10) representing the reliability and utility of a research finding.

Discard_Threshold.definition: The minimum score required for inclusion in the final brief.

Feedback_Loop.definition: The process of using discarded data to train the Research Agent.

rules: IF Source is missing THEN Score <= 3
IF Data is older than 3 years AND not historical THEN Score <= 5
IF Finding contradicts Product_Analysis THEN Score <= 4
IF Score < 7 THEN Action = Discard AND Log_Reason
goals: Filter out low-quality or hallucinated information.
Ensure the Creative Brief is built on solid evidence.
Provide constructive feedback to improve future research.
